vectors.name: eof-top-level
vectors.description: A top-level opener with no closer hides the rest of the document.

vectors.name: eof-alone
vectors.description: An opener on the last line is unclosed too.

vectors.name: opener-tail
vectors.description: The opener's tail is not part of the delimiter.

vectors.name: shorter-closer
vectors.description: A closer shorter than the opener does not close it.

vectors.name: longer-closer
vectors.description: A closer longer than the opener does not close it either.

vectors.name: indented-opener
vectors.description: An indented opener is reported at its first percent sign.

vectors.name: list-item
vectors.description: A line that misses the item ends the span and the item (PART 0 S1).

vectors.name: marker-line
vectors.description: An opener on a list item's marker line opens a span in the item.

vectors.name: quote
vectors.description: An unmarked blank line ends the quote and the span in it.

vectors.name: footnote-body
vectors.description: A line below the body column ends the footnote and the span.

vectors.name: colon-closer-is-payload
vectors.description: A colon closer inside an unclosed span is payload, so the container runs to the end.

vectors.name: line-block
vectors.description: An unclosed span in a line block hides the block's own closer.

vectors.name: closer-after-a-missing-line
vectors.description: A closer past a line that misses the span's owner does not close it (PART 0 S1).

vectors.name: closed
vectors.description: An exact-width closer closes the span.

vectors.name: closed-tails
vectors.description: Tails on either delimiter line do not matter.

vectors.name: closed-indented
vectors.description: An indented closer closes an indented opener.

vectors.name: closer-below-column
vectors.description: An exact closer below the host's column still closes the span.

vectors.name: nested-shorter
vectors.description: A longer opener holds a shorter fence pair as payload.

vectors.name: line-comment
vectors.description: A two-percent line is a line comment, not a fence.

vectors.name: in-code
vectors.description: A percent run inside a code block is code.

vectors.name: inline-text
vectors.description: A percent run inside a paragraph line is text.
